    • doGet

      protected void doGet(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response) throws jakarta.servlet.ServletException, IOException
      Handle requests for editing unique tokens. Two basic requests are supported:
      • find the unique tokens for a given user
      • the update request is a combination of adding new tokens, updating existing tokens and deleting existing tokens

      doGet() begins by obtaining a reference to com.yardi.ejb.UserProfileBean and com.yardi.ejb.UniqueTokensBean from JNDI.

      The request is first deserialized to com.yardi.QSECOFR.EditUniqueTokensRequest. At this point, only the action, findUser, and uniqueTokensString fields in EditUniqueTokensRequest are populated. Field uniqueTokensString contains a JSON array.

      If the request is an update request, then the uniqueTokensString field in EditUniqueTokensRequest is deserialized to a Vector<EditUniqueTokensRequest>. Now fields up1UserName, up1Token, up1DateAdded, up1Rrn, and deleteToken are populated. doGet() calls updateTokens() to handle the rest of the update request.

      If the request is a find request doGet calls findTokens() to further handle the request.

      Finally doGet() responds to the web request.

    • findTokens

      private boolean findTokens(String userName, UserProfile userProfileBean, UniqueTokens uniqueTokenBean, Vector<Unique_Tokens> uniqueTokens, EditUniqueTokensRequest editRequest)
      Handle the find request by finding all tokens for the given user. Delegate to com.yardi.ejb.UniqueTokensBean.findTokens(userName) to get the tokens. The user tokens are stored in field uniqueTokens on the edit request com.yardi.QSECOFR.EditUniqueTokensRequest.

    • updateTokens

      private void updateTokens(UniqueTokens uniqueTokenBean, Vector<Unique_Tokens> uniqueTokens, Vector<EditUniqueTokensRequest> updatedTokens)
      Handle the update request. An update request is a combination of adding new tokens, updating existing tokens and deleting existing tokens.

      Because com.yardi.QSECOFR.EditUniqueTokensRequest.up1DateAdded maps to String, a java.util.Calendar is constructed from the month, day, century and year components of up1DateAdded so that the mills from this calendar can be passed to UniqueTokensBean.updateToken.

      Tokens with a relative record number of >0 are tokens that exist in the database table UNIQUE_TOKENS. Tokens being added have a negative relative record number. Tokens having a positive relative record number that are not being deleted are updated.

      If EditUniqueTokensRequest.deleteToken is true then the token is being deleted. Delegate to UniqueTokensBean.remove() to remove the token from the database.

      If the relative record number is greater than zero and the token is not being deleted then the token is updated. Delegate to UniqueTokensBean.updateToken().

      If the relative record number is negative then persist the token to database table UNIQUE_TOKENS. Delegate to UniqueTokensBean.persist().

      Parameters:
      uniqueTokenBean - reference to com.yardi.ejb.UniqueTokensBean
      uniqueTokens - Vector<com.yardi.ejb.Unique_Tokens>
      updatedTokens - Vector<com.yardi.QSECOFR.EditUniqueTokensRequest>
